item.title: RT David Juurlink: Re In short, losartan is the codeine of ARBs: - it doesn't do much on its own - any effect is due to a metabolite - metabolite form...
item.description:
RT David Juurlink
Re In short, losartan is the codeine of ARBs:

- it doesn't do much on its own
- any effect is due to a metabolite
- metabolite formation is genetically determined

The result? Unpredictability and potential interactions with CYP inhibitors & inducers.

And who needs that?

/ end

item.title: RT Edgar V. Lerma 🇵🇭: Transition from an eGFR-based to a risk-based approach to CKD care from @goKDIGO #Nephpearls 📌 Practice Point 2.2.1: A ...
item.description:
RT Edgar V. Lerma 🇵🇭
Transition from an eGFR-based to a risk-based approach to CKD care from @goKDIGO #Nephpearls

📌 Practice Point 2.2.1: A 5-year kidney failure risk of 3%–5% can be used to determine need for nephrology referral in addition to criteria based on eGFR or urine ACR, and other clinical considerations

📌 Practice Point 2.2.2: A 2-year kidney failure risk of >10% can be used to determine the timing of multidisciplinary care in addition to eGFR-based criteria and other clinical considerations

⚠️Practice Point 2.2.4: Note that risk prediction equations developed for use in people with CKD G3-G5, may not be valid for use in those with CKD G1-G2

👉 https://kdigo.org/guidelines/ckd-evaluation-and-management/
